ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixel distribution concentrated in linear streaks and circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear streaks distributed across both lobes; dense clusters of white circular pixel blobs located at the distal tips (lobes) and along the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a wide angle; vertex partially obscured by splash, but visible depth indicates a distinct separation between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of irregular, medium-frequency serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes (peaks and valleys) along the entire boundary from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the outer tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups on the outer tips of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying orientations and lengths across the visible fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant scarring in the form of multiple rake marks and heavy calcified barnacle colonization at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-density cross-hatch pattern of linear scars located in the upper-mid region of the right lobe.
